objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with progressive pain and blurry vision in one eye.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’m a 45-year-old kindergarten teacher, and for the past day I’ve had increasing pain and blurry vision in my right eye. It’s been hard to open that eye because of the discomfort, and my left eye feels completely normal. I also regularly wear contact lenses, and I haven’t changed anything in my routine until this started.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden uncontrollable movements that you can’t stop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any involuntary twitching, jerking, or shaking, and there haven’t been any sudden uncontrollable movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves a bit under the skin** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any lump or changes in my right breast, and there’s no painful or movable area.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, pressing or gently tapping around my belly button area doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (even if it comes and goes)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast—no swelling or changes that come and go.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a fogged window? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t notice any cloudiness or haziness in both eyes—my left eye looks normal, and it’s mainly the right eye that’s blurry.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any **unintentional weight loss** recently—meaning you’ve lost weight without trying (for example, over the past few months)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any unintentional weight loss recently—I feel like my weight has been stable.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump or mass in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** (painless), even if it’s small or you just found it recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, and there’s no painless, movable area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been pregnant recently, or is there any chance you could be pregnant right now?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I’m not pregnant, and there’s no chance of pregnancy.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a breast lump or swelling that seems to move or shift when you touch it, rather than staying fixed in one spot?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or swelling at all, so there’s nothing that would move or shift when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself avoiding using your right knee because it hurts? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not avoiding using my right knee—I haven’t had any knee pain or issues; it’s only my right eye that’s been bothering me with increasing pain and blurry vision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you’ve been walking slower than usual lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed that I’m walking slower than usual—I’m mainly dealing with pain and blurry vision in my right eye, and the left side feels normal.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. Have you had any discomfort or pain in your lower abdomen (below your belly button) recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any discomfort or pain in my lower abdomen below my belly button. It’s been focused on my right eye—pain, blurry vision, and it’s been hard to open that eye.”
